integrity: Exact rational derivations and a standalone finite symbolic check; no independent review or certification is asserted.
limitations: Only uniform directed cyclic CTMC generators, exact [2/2] Padé endpoint, exact arithmetic; n>=5 is analyzed for large steps only, not its complete positivity set. This does not address internal stages, floating point, unrelated Markov generators or accuracy optimality.
title: Sharp four-state positivity frontier for fourth-order Padé steps on directed Markov cycles
